requirement: identity/email explicit verification auto-signin with original remember policy

request.Confirmation: VerificationConfirmRequest: original delivered registration grant and callback
request.Device: trusted bounded current risk correlation, not identity authority
request.remember: absent: recover resolved policy from authenticated encrypted signup intent

result.Issuance: separate session-owned child outcome and reveal-once delivery
result.Recovery: exact child scope; metadata-only, never execution or disclosure authority

transactions: original verification-confirm commits address 1 -> 2, one-use grant, audit and lifecycle
only its fresh successful invocation may attempt linked session 0 -> 1 with audit and lifecycle
unique tenant/confirmation parent prevents two child issuances
current directory, recipient, authorization and original factor generation are fenced before final commit
unknown/replayed verification creates no child; unknown/replayed child reveals no credential
authentication: email possession, not password comparison or a renewed signup proof
factor_profile: known-empty authoritative MFA only; enrolled/unknown deny without fallback; enrolled continuation remains separate required work

http.cookies: original signup flow and signed browser-device cookie
http.response: parent confirmation plus optional child signin metadata; fresh secure HttpOnly cookie and X-CSRF-Token only
http.defaults: verification-only; managed/address-change profiles acquire no login

acceptance: browser and persistent original remember choices through native and selected HTTPS
real registration, captured delivery, verification, signin, primary read and logout
wrong original browser and absent HTTP browser/device deny
policy, missing/nonempty factors, blocked account and unavailable risk deny
rollback of either transaction preserves the other observed outcome accurately
contending confirmations produce one verification and at most one child
lost actual commit acknowledgements at both boundaries withhold credentials and retain recovery
default and shared managed confirmation remain verification-only
